builds.name: Reference: Repeated on-hit
builds.goal: Reference for Kog'Maw: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A stationary ranged damage engine who either exploits W's long-range max-health attacks or uses spells to soften enemies beyond attack range. Separate W's max-health attacks from R artillery and rising mana cost. Confirm phantom/bolt applications and Q shred rather than assigning full item damage to every spell. Actual attacks can combine on-hit effects, attack speed and stacked defenses/penetration.
builds.summary: Actual attacks can combine on-hit effects, attack speed and stacked defenses/penetration.
testPlan: Kit question for Kog'Maw: Separate W's max-health attacks from R artillery and rising mana cost. Confirm phantom/bolt applications and Q shred rather than assigning full item damage to every spell.

Start with the early core (BotRK, then Rageblade) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Actual attacks can combine on-hit effects, attack speed and stacked defenses/penetration. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile which deals magic damage and corrodes the target's armor and magic resist for a short time. Kog'Maw also gains additional attack speed. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Ramp and target contact are required; on-attack effects are not all copied by phantom hits.

The route fails Kog'Maw's stated kit question: Separate W's max-health attacks from R artillery and rising mana cost. Confirm phantom/bolt applications and Q shred rather than assigning full item damage to every spell.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Ramp and target contact are required; on-attack effects are not all copied by phantom hits.
Full cost 16,300 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: BotRK, then Rageblade. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Terminus, Wit's End, Guardian Angel are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Ap Barrage Repeat
builds.summary: Log W on-hit packets during Dusk and fully stacked Rageblade.
builds.goal: Log W on-hit packets during Dusk and fully stacked Rageblade.
builds.hypothesis: W supplies eight seconds of AP-scaled max-health magic On-Hit and extra range; Q removes both resists. Nashor/Dusk/Rageblade tests a personal on-hit attack window with AP scaling and Phantom Hit, without assigning passive death damage to attacks.
testPlan: Required state: W active and Q shred lands; record Rageblade ramp and Dusk availability.
Log W on-hit packets during Dusk and fully stacked Rageblade; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Low defense or delayed attacks wastes the eight-second duration.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Repeated on-hits do not grant extra W duration or attack range.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Artillery Threshold Reveal
builds.summary: Compare R damage at 41% versus 39% while recording cast costs.
builds.goal: Compare R damage at 41% versus 39% while recording cast costs.
builds.hypothesis: R doubles its base packet below 40% target health and Shadowflame uses the same threshold for magic damage. E slow and Q shred improve a follow-up artillery aim; Seraph provides finite mana and Horizon adds long-range reveal for subsequent shots.
testPlan: Required state: Enemy below 40%; track R casts within eight seconds and actual mana. Earn Seraph transformation through recorded Tear stacks before using this six-slot state.
Compare R damage at 41% versus 39% while recording cast costs; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Escalating R cost reaches 400 and misses exhaust mana.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: R missing-health ramp and below-40% doubled branch are not freely multiplied together.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
